_comment: Built-in emojis. The server adds these to the database on first start (and the admin page can restore missing ones). 'on' = shown to players from the start; the rest wait in the library. Pictures: <id>.png, drawn for this project with Codex image generation.

emojis.label: Thumbs up
emojis.draw: a thumbs-up hand wearing a steel knight gauntlet with a blue and gold cuff

emojis.label: Clap
emojis.draw: two steel knight gauntlets clapping, with small motion lines

emojis.label: Tears of joy
emojis.draw: classic round yellow emoji face laughing with big tears of joy

emojis.label: Rolling laughing
emojis.draw: classic round yellow emoji face tilted sideways, rolling with laughter, tears flying

emojis.label: Cool
emojis.draw: classic round yellow emoji face with black sunglasses and a small shiny steel soldier helmet on top

emojis.label: Thinking
emojis.draw: classic round yellow emoji face thinking, one raised eyebrow, a steel-gauntlet hand on the chin

emojis.label: Shocked
emojis.draw: classic round yellow emoji face screaming in shock, hands on cheeks, pale blue forehead

emojis.label: Crying
emojis.draw: classic round yellow emoji face crying loudly with two streams of tears

emojis.label: Angry
emojis.draw: classic round emoji face, red and furious, frowning, a small puff of steam
